policy: Interior-feature checks require more than one source pixel of clearance from the square boundary. All observed pixels remain in image error. Geometry, paper and image-error thresholds are unchanged. Routing can also be triggered by poor grid agreement without missing components.

web.methodology: Original photographs and rough ROIs, automatic crops, fresh initialization and independent resvg replay. Passes are candidate checks, not validated ground-truth recovery. Before values come from PROVISIONAL-ROUTING-VALIDATION.json.

browser.methodology: Actual production editor with its 180-second budget. Page-clock Find-to-ready timing; downloaded editable SVG error. Every captured source mask and crop is compared with the previous run.
